svg.title: Orionids radiant finder
svg.desc: North up, east left. Yellow open circle: nominal peak radiant. Blue constellation figures and green asterisms use accepted Star Almanack geometry. Reference stars are magnitude-scaled.
svg.text: Nominal peak position: RA 95° · Dec +16° · north up, east left
Yellow: nominal radiant · blue: constellations · green: orienting asterisms
Star Almanack chart · IMO nominal peak coordinates · accepted HYG/Hipparcos figure stars
Radiant drifts through the shower; orientation is celestial, not a local horizon view.
